scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @memory-lane/server" "npm run dev -w @memory-lane/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @memory-lane/shared && npm run build -w @memory-lane/server && npm run build -w @memory-lane/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @memory-lane/shared && npm run build -w @memory-lane/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @memory-lane/shared && npm run build -w @memory-lane/web
